items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: At the Savoy and I had to leave Jimmy Noon. I hated to leave him because I liked his band and I liked the way Father Hines played you know.

ctx.x: Yes I see, that was after it became the Apex, after the (Nest?) became the Apex.

That's right. But I found out that Louis was going to go ahead with Carroll Dickerson's band because it was rumored all around, you know. At the Savoy and I had to leave Jimmy Noon. I hated to leave him because I liked his band and I liked the way Father Hines played you know. And that's when we opened at the Savoy.
Did Earl leave to go with Carroll Dickerson then?
